propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Da nobis, quaesumus, Domine, imitari quod colimus: ut discamus et
inimicos diligere; quia ejus natalicia celebramus, qui novit etiam pro
persecutoribus exorare Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum:
Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

refused.hebrew: roman-1962 numbers Acts divergently (the Vulgate joins the two verses of Stephen's vision into one, its 7:55 carrying both the sight of the glory of God and the Ecce video caelos apertos that the Greek numbers 7:56, so its chapter 7 ends at 59 where the Greek ends at 60 and everything from the Greek's 7:56 stands one verse lower, its 7:59 also carrying the Greek's 8:1a. This day's four Acts citations do not all speak one system. The Lesson, printed 7, 54-59, is the Vulgate's - it ends at obdormivit in Domino, which the Vulgate numbers 7:59 and the Greek 7:60 - and it resolves to itself. The Alleluia, Offertory and Communion carry the Greek's numbers against chants whose words the Vulgate prints elsewhere. Video caelos apertos is the Vulgate's 7:55, not its 7:56, which is the crowd stopping its ears. Accipe spiritum meum is the Vulgate's 7:58, not its 7:59, which is ne statuas illis hoc peccatum. And 7:60 is past the end of the Vulgate's chapter altogether. Recorded as cited and corrected here rather than rewritten in the propers, because the printed numbers have not been read on the page images); this edition is in hebrew numbering and the locus records no ruling for it beyond 'unrecorded'

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Suscipe, Domine, munera pro tuorum commemoratione Sanctorum: ut, sicut
illos passio gloriosos effecit; ita nos devotio reddat innocuos. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat
in unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Auxilientur nobis, Domine, sumpta mysteria: et, intercedente beato
Stephano Martyre tuo, sempiterna protectione confirment. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in
unitate.
